title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. fragiliforme
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. fragiliforme, commonly known as hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Iberian Peninsula and parts of the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. fragiliforme include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to reduce swelling and pain, and its potential to exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
